body: An official website of the United States government. * Productivity and Costs by Industry: Manufacturing and Mining Industries 06/24/2026. In May, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.5 percent, seasonally adjusted, and rose 4.2 percent over the last 12 months, not seasonally adjusted. The index for all items less food and energy increased 0.2 percent in May (SA); up 2.9 percent over the year (NSA). The Producer Price Index for final demand rose 1.1 percent in May. Prices for final demand goods increased 2.8 percent, and the index for final demand services moved up 0.3 percent. Productivity increased 0.3 percent in the nonfarm business sector in the first quarter of 2026; unit labor costs increased 1.8 percent (seasonally adjusted annual rates). In manufacturing, productivity increased 3.2 percent and unit labor costs increased 2.2 percent. In May, U.S. import prices rose 1.9 percent following an increase of 2.0 percent in April. * State Employment and Unemployment (PDF) (Charts).
